limits: Existing speech/backgrounds are explored comparison sets, not fresh blind tests.
Counterfactual check covers classifier conditioning, not reference-dependent API alignment.
Outside-pair class cannot diagnose a particular nonnasal error.
No speech-in-noise, omission, repetition or real microphone validation.
Sparse pairs use a shared head, not validated pair specialists.
Unmarked syllables are not verified correct actual pronunciations.
No acoustic scores, API intervals or gold labels collected.
Only recordings already containing explicit nasal errors and assigned to train are inventoried.
No development or evaluation speakers are eligible.
API flags and alignment availability cannot certify unmarked pronunciations as correct.
All selected targets, including rejected/uncached ones, remain in the inventory.
